summary.text: Jack Ducharme, who appears on the ballot as John Ducharme, is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 71 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A banker, he has served in the Maine House since 2020.

paragraphs.text: John "Jack" Ducharme lives in Madison, Maine.
He earned an A.S. in business management from Kennebec Valley Community College in 2002 and a B.S. in business administration from Thomas College in 2012.
His career experience includes working as vice president and regional community banker with Skowhegan Savings Bank, a relationship manager with KeyBank, and a manager with Oakes & Parkhurst Glass.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with the Madison Business Alliance, the Skowhegan Area Chamber of Commerce, the Guardian Angel Council, and the Knights of Columbus.
Ducharme won election to the Maine House in 2020 from District 111 and won District 71 in 2022 and 2024.
He served on the Innovation, Development, Economic Advancement and Business Committee in 2021-2022 and on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee in 2023-2024.
